rows.reason: Croquis marks type/interface exports that use `typeof <setup value>` as not hoisted, and Canon's virtual TS keeps them inside `__setup`. TypeExport.hoisted is read only by Canon's virtual TS generator; atelier_sfc does not consume type_exports.

Canon's batch virtual project now re-exports named exports from split-script .vue modules, and Croquis::merge_plain_script keeps the regular <script>'s NonScriptSetup scope for virtual TS. compile_sfc reads bindings, not the merged scope chain, so compiled output cannot differ; the change only feeds `vize check`.

Croquis now records the declaration offset of each v-for alias (and stops re-adding duplicate SetupConst bindings at offset 0) so Patina reports unused v-for aliases at the alias span. Declaration offsets feed only lint diagnostics; the template compiler does not read Croquis v-for scope offsets.

vize check CLI plumbing: sharded corsa CLI execution, tsconfig extends inlining, slot-prop annotations and const-generic stripping in canon virtual TS, and const-modifier stripping in croquis declaration (.d.ts) emit. None of these feed compile_sfc or the template compilers.

The fix replaces a byte-slice in vize_canon's virtual TS generator (is_use_template_ref_binding) with a checked `get`, so type-checker virtual TS generation no longer panics on multibyte script comments. The croquis change is a test only; no compiler (atelier) code changed, so compiled output cannot differ.

Only the Croquis virtual-TS preamble type `__WithDefaultsResult` changed (Omit & mapped -? type -> Omit & Required<Pick<...>>) plus type-checker snapshots. That text is emitted only into Canon's virtual TypeScript for type checking; compile_sfc/compile_template never emit it.

clone_expression now flattens a Compound expression to a Simple one carrying its source. Compound expression nodes are only built in unit tests; the parser and transforms hand process_inline_handler Simple nodes, so no public input reaches the changed arm and output cannot differ.

The change fills defineModel type/required/default metadata in vize_croquis::script_parser and feeds it into Canon's virtual TypeScript props/emits. compile_sfc builds its own defineModel props/emits (vize_atelier_sfc script/define_model_metadata.rs) and never reads these Croquis fields, so compiled output cannot differ; this is type-checker-only analysis.
Changes only the Croquis virtual-TS template generator (typed v-for alias emission) and a Patina type-aware test. Virtual TS feeds the type checker/linter only; compiled render output is untouched.

Reduces reactivity-loss false positives: croquis plain-value/destructure origin tracking, croquis_cf reactivity and lifecycle-cleanup diagnostics, Patina no-reactivity-loss rule and canon checks. This is linter/type-checker analysis only; no binding types or compiler inputs change.

Croquis's script parser now records top-level static object literals and expands `...spread` entries inside runtime defineProps/defineEmits objects into prop/emit definitions and bindings. Croquis ScriptParseResult macros feed Canon virtual TS and Patina; the SFC compiler builds props/emits/bindings from its own ScriptCompileContext and runtime_object_literals is read nowhere else.

Cross-file provide/inject analysis (vize_croquis_cf) now resolves slot-projected children against the component that writes them, used by `vize lint --cross-file`. The vize_croquis visit_element change only memoizes element_subtree_end; scope bounds are identical, so no compiled output changes.

Croquis plain-script parsing registers exported value declarations as bindings, and the undefined-binding analysis reports the expression offset. Both feed only the Canon type checker and the linter; compile_sfc collects normal-script bindings with its own collector and parses only script setup through Croquis, whose path is unchanged.
Marks LegacyDialectCapabilities #[non_exhaustive] and bumps workspace/npm versions to 0.205.0. An API-compatibility attribute and version strings cannot change compiled output.
Croquis reactivity-loss detection ignores value-sink calls (emit, Number, console.*, JSON.stringify, Math.*). Reactivity losses feed only Patina/Canon diagnostics; the compiler does not read them.

Adds an owning-component field to Croquis `VSlotScopeData` so Canon can type scoped-slot props from the child component's defineSlots. The atelier transform sets the field to `None` and never reads it; codegen is unchanged.

Changes vize_canon virtual TS generation, the `vize check` Nuxt command and croquis runtime-prop type extraction (extract_props_from_runtime), which at this commit fed only the type checker/linter (compile_sfc used its own ScriptCompileContext for props codegen). Compiled output cannot differ; the added .vue files are type-check project fixtures.

Adds analyze_sfc_descriptor_resolved / merge_resolved_props_into_croquis in vize_atelier_sfc::croquis and switches the canon SFC type checker, typecheck service and maestro virtual TS to it, so props inherited through imported/heritage types are not flagged as undefined template references. compile_sfc never calls the new entry, so compiled output cannot differ; only type-check diagnostics and virtual TS change.

Corsa/LSP session overlays, `vize check`/`vize fmt` CLI plumbing, Maestro virtual-code and completion work, and test scratch paths. The only atelier_sfc edits move test scratch directories; no compiler source changed.

Teaches croquis script parsing to extract runtime `defineEmits({...})` / array emits with payload types for vize_canon's untyped-emit diagnostics. The compiler's runtime `emits` codegen comes from its own ScriptCompileContext and did not read croquis emit definitions, so compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis's drawer keeps a parent-component stack so a `<template #name>` slot host records its owning component in VSlotScopeData, letting Canon type the slot props from that component's $slots instead of `any`. Only the Croquis scope data read by Canon virtual TS changes; compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis now keeps each template identifier's root offset (extract_identifier_refs_oxc) so undefined-reference diagnostics point at the real occurrence (`name` in `user.name + name`) instead of the first substring match. UndefinedRef offsets feed only Canon/Patina diagnostics; the template and SFC compilers never read them.

Changes only croquis cross-file component resolution (is_builtin_component now normalizes kebab-case names), which feeds cross-file lint diagnostics (UnregisteredComponent). The compiler does not use the cross-file analyzer, so compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis records argument-less object-form v-on (`v-on="{ ... }"`) as a VOn template expression instead of synthesizing an event handler, so Canon's virtual TS emits `void ({ ... }); // VOn`. Template expressions feed only the type checker and linter; DOM/SSR/Vapor codegen does not consume them.

Croquis now records whether a v-slot argument is dynamic (ScopeChain::dynamic_v_slot_scopes) so Canon's virtual TS types `v-slot:[name]` props from the union of all declared slots instead of a static slot key. The scope-chain flag is read only by vize_canon virtual TS generation; the SFC/template compilers do not consume Croquis v-slot scope data.

Changes only the Croquis virtual-TS generator for template event handlers and the Patina native type-aware no-floating-promises query. Both feed the linter/type checker; no atelier compiler crate changed, so compiled output cannot differ. (Later work reversed the lint verdict to ignore member handlers; still lint-only.)

Rewrites vize_croquis ImportResolver::extract_type_definitions from regex scanning to an OXC AST walk. At the commit its only callers were croquis virtual_ts (type checking); at HEAD nothing outside import_resolver.rs uses it. The SFC compiler resolves imported types through its own script context, so compiled output cannot differ.

Adds value_bindings to the Croquis v-for scope so destructured aliases bind every name for virtual TS, unused-var analysis and type-aware lint. The only atelier_core edit populates the new field with the single existing value alias, so the compiler scope chain and compiled output are unchanged.

Canon virtual TS now reads local interface/type-alias prop fields from a croquis TypeResolver populated by an AST walk instead of a text scanner; croquis gains Croquis.types and register_local_type. Only canon virtual TS / vue_codegen consume these, so compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis now records v-on TemplateExpression start/end from the expression span instead of the whole directive span, which only shifts Canon's virtual-TS source-map ranges for type-check diagnostics. atelier_sfc's Croquis analysis runs with `collect_template_expressions: false` (crates/vize_atelier_sfc/src/croquis.rs), so compiled output cannot change.

Canon's virtual TS now types template props declared through withDefaults as default-resolved (Required<Pick<...>>), changing only the generated virtual TypeScript and its snapshots. No vize_atelier_* code changed, so compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis now records specifier-only `export { X }` / `export type { X }` statements in script setup as `re_exports`, and Canon lifts them out of the synthetic `__setup()` in the virtual TS. No vize_atelier_* crate reads `re_exports`, so compiled output cannot differ.

CI repair: renames VueDialect to VueVersion in vize_armature legacy.rs (type rename only, identical capability tables) and updates vize check declaration-emit test expectations for the shared __vize_helpers.d.ts. No compiler code path changes.

Restores the public transform_v_if(ctx, exp, is_root) signature as a wrapper over the new transform_v_if_with_directive, which traverse now calls with identical arguments. The compiler pipeline runs the same code as after #1255, so compiled output is byte-identical.
Changes only the Croquis virtual-TS template generator (v-if narrowing) and the Patina template query collector. Both feed type checking/linting; no compiler crate output changes.

Croquis builds sibling-aware v-if/v-else-if/v-else narrowing guards (negated preceding conditions) and Canon emits them in the virtual TS. The guards only feed type checking; no compile_sfc/compile_template output reads them.

Routes template expressions containing `/` through croquis' OXC slow path so regex literals are not reported as identifiers; this feeds Maestro's undefined-binding diagnostics. extract_identifiers_oxc is not used by any atelier compiler crate, so compiled output cannot differ.

Changes `vite_plugin::scope_css_for_pipeline` (the Vite/Nuxt CSS extraction helper exposed through vize_vitrine) to keep leading `/* ... */` comments before a scoped rule or @media block, plus vite-plugin-vize JS changes. compile_sfc and compile_template do not call this pipeline helper.

Croquis plain-script parsing now resolves Options API `components` registrations through const bindings, spreads and `export default <identifier>`, and stops reporting value exports in plain scripts as invalid. `component_registrations` and plain-script `invalid_exports` feed only Maestro, Patina and Canon; compile_sfc never reads them (it parses script setup only via parse_script_setup).

Derives croquis script-setup is_async from a top-level-await AST walk and drops the canon text scan for "await ", so canon virtual TS emits async __setup only for real top-level await. No compiler crate reads the croquis is_async flag (checked at the commit), so compiled output cannot differ.

Adds a new public `validate_script_setup_semantics` entry point (props-destructure default type validation) and calls it from Canon batch registration and Maestro LSP diagnostics. compile_sfc already ran the same validator; its code, errors and every other result field are unchanged.

Performance follow-up to #1283: the Croquis identifier cache goes back to plain names and the undefined-ref offset is recomputed only for undefined identifiers with a word-boundary search; Canon's instance-global refs use the same name lookup. Only diagnostic offsets in Croquis/Canon are touched; compiled output cannot differ.

Adds Options API `components` registration collection to croquis script parsing and widens the croquis analyzer's is_component_tag; both feed patina's vue/no-unused-components only. compile_sfc neither reads component_registrations nor calls is_component_tag, so compiled output cannot differ.
